items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser suits dry-feeling skin and won't compete with the retinol.
The lower 0.3% strength is a sensible starting point for smoother-looking texture and more even-looking tone.
A rich ceramide and glycerin cream helps support comfort and moisture while your skin adjusts to retinol.
Daily sunscreen is needed with retinol, and the tinted iron-oxide formula suits deeper skin tones and uneven-looking tone.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night, starting 2 nights a week and building up slowly as your skin stays comfortable, and skip other exfoliating acids for now. Apply sunscreen every morning and reapply when outdoors.
